name: Signal
description: Talk to any Vicuna Work session from Signal (Note to Self, solo groups, or DMs) via signal-cli, with QR linking, live progress, questions, attachments, and voice memos.

setupSteps.text: Install signal-cli (e.g. brew install signal-cli on macOS) from
Click Link Signal device below to generate a QR code.
In Signal on your phone, open Settings → Linked Devices → Link New Device and scan the QR code.
